shots.text: I ran home faster than any ant has ever run.
shots.note: Flat-out run through the tunnels, speed lines.

shots.text: I screamed it through every tunnel: they're coming.
shots.note: Sound waves pour out of him.

shots.text: A soldier {impact}pushed me into the dirt and said, "Go carry your crumbs, 250."
shots.note: A soldier shoves 250 into the dirt.

shots.text: By sunrise the walls were burning.
Our queen was dragged out in chains... and I watched.
shots.note: The queen dragged away in chains; 250 watches in the foreground.
